long_biography.plain_text:
Born in 1962, Antunes is the son of printmaker Maria Bonomi and stage director José Alves Antunes Filho. Through his mother's family he descends from Giuseppe Martinelli, an Italian immigrant whose early Brazilian ventures included construction and shipping. That heritage supplies important context, but it does not reveal how Antunes funded or assembled his own portfolio.

His clearest executive appointment has been at a Mococa-based farming company that cultivates oranges and markets teak. He also held shares in Malta-registered Tereticornis Ltd, using the same rural São Paulo address. These connections point to operational responsibility in agriculture and some international investment activity, without establishing founder status, controlling ownership or the original source of his capital.
